T_k: The correction keeps the saturating even x4 term, about -0.09 at x4 = 0 and levelling off near +0.2 for |x4| > 2, and doubles the amplitude of the tanh-bounded x2*x5 interaction. Same-sign x2/x5 pairs now add about +0.2 at x2*x5 = 1, and opposite-sign pairs subtract a similar amount, which offsets the x4 boost when |x4| is large but the product is negative.
